reality_delta: The proposed fix changes the reviewer contract (prompt + template + self-check) so that review-verdict.json explicitly carries terminal_completion=false and separates runner-owned completion steps from reviewer open items. This is a tightening of the contract, not a relaxation of the validator. It directly addresses the observed Round10 failure mode where the reviewer artifact was produced but the validator rejected it for a missing explicit field.
main_concern: The failure-backlog clarification is directionally correct but must be narrowly scoped. If it is worded as a blanket exemption for 'runner-owned follow-up,' the reviewer could use it to avoid flagging blocking issues that are genuinely in upstream evidence. The safety of the fix depends entirely on the exact phrasing: the distinction must be 'runner finalization steps vs. reviewer-discovered defects,' not 'anything the runner will do later is exempt.'
top_risks: The failure-backlog clarification could be over-interpreted, allowing the reviewer to omit real blocking open items by labeling them runner-owned follow-up.
Self-check coverage for prompt/template contents may not catch all generation paths or downstream copies, leaving older variants that still omit terminal_completion=false.
If the runner validator does not also check the new runner-owned-follow-up field for presence and proper separation, a malformed verdict could slip through.
missing_evidence: Current reviewer prompt text and review-verdict-template.json as generated by prepare_project.
Runner validator code that enforces review-verdict.terminal_completion=false.
Round10 source_workspace_guard logs and upstream role evidence proving the workspace stayed clean.
minimum_fix: Apply the four proposed changes, then add a targeted unit test that renders the reviewer prompt and template for a sample project and asserts (1) terminal_completion=false appears verbatim, (2) the failure-backlog schema distinguishes open_items from runner_owned_follow_up, and (3) a synthetic pass verdict with only runner-owned follow-up passes validate_reviewer_outputs. Only after that passes should full E2E be rerun.

anti_loop_signal.reason: This fix does not substitute documentation for action. It changes the actual prompt/template contract so the generated verdict contains a field the validator already requires. The work product is a behavior change in the reviewer output, not an explanatory note.

user_intent_alignment: High. The user authorized continuing RedCap revival, explicitly does not want the completion marker weakened, and wants reviewer validation preserved. The proposal fixes the contract gap without relaxing terminal completion checks and keeps Prism/provider execution out of the reviewer role.
